ns2:section.sectionText: This class is designed to facilitate student success and wellness in engineering. The class will cover skills that will be transferable to any work environment, focusing on setting realistic goals, timelines, and expectations; designing workable class and daily schedules; and organizing and actively engaging in personal and professional development, while balancing priorities and wellness.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Civil Engineering or Computer Engineering or Computer Science or Electrical Engineering or Engineering Mechanics or Engineering Physics or Industrial Engineering or Materials Science & Engr or Mechanical Engineering or Chemical Engineering or Bioengineering or Agrophysiology or PreEngineering or Aerospace Engineering or Agricultural & Biological Engr or Nuclear, Plasma, Radiolgc Engr or Engineering Undeclared or Systems Engineering and Design major(s).
